prompts.title: Roman Bust Image Prompt
prompts.prompt:
Photorealistic portrait of a classical Roman marble bust of [SUBJECT], carved in the veristic style. The face is rendered with hyperreal human detail — natural pores, deep forehead furrows, crow's feet, faint stubble — while the entire surface reads unmistakably as aged marble: fine craquelure, hairline fissures, mineral veining, and chipped edges along the shoulder. Thick sculpted hair. Head turned three-quarters, chin slightly raised, gaze directed off-frame toward an upper light source; expression resolute and severe. Draped toga carved in deep, heavy folds over one shoulder, fastened with a large circular bronze medallion embossed with a lion's head and a ring of Latin lettering; scale-armor pauldron visible beneath. Bust terminates on a round marble plinth at the bottom of the frame.
Lighting: single dramatic warm key light from upper left, deep chiaroscuro, strong falloff into shadow. Background is an abstract swirling nebula of dark umber and smoke, glowing faintly behind the silhouette, no architecture or horizon. Monochrome sepia palette throughout — burnt umber, bronze, warm ivory — heavy vignette, subtle film grain, low overall saturation.
Shot as if with an 85mm lens at f/2.8, shallow depth of field, museum-catalogue framing with the head in the upper third. Ultra-detailed, 8K, cinematic.
Aspect ratio 4:5.
Negative: color, blue tones, flat even lighting, plastic or CGI skin, cartoon, text watermark, modern clothing, full body, multiple figures.

prompts.title: Papercraft Portrait
prompts.prompt: Create a hyper-detailed, origami-style version of a person based on the reference image image_0.png, folded from high-quality paper with crisp, clean edges and a realistic paper texture. Intricate geometric folds capture the character’s iconic shape and expressions. The image features a symmetrical, front-facing bust pose with the subject looking directly forward. Use the same color (skin tone, outfit color, hair color) palette as the reference photo (no black). Place it on a clean white studio backdrop with soft, natural shadows(no objects on the background). A minimalist collectable art aesthetic; ultra-photorealistic; 8k, 1080×1080 square.

prompts.title: Stunning Visuals in Wood
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image as the exact facial reference. Preserve the person’s facial features, skin tone, hairstyle, beard grooming, and calm with precise accuracy. Do not stylize or change identity.
Create an ultra-realistic wooden relief portrait sculpture, carved into a premium solid walnut panel. The face must look deeply carved with refined chisel textures, realistic depth, subtle tool marks, and a smooth hand-polished finish. Emphasize natural walnut grain flowing across the carved surface.
Color tone / grading (must match):

Keep the overall image color tone warm, cinematic, and premium, with golden-hour amber highlights, soft warm browns, and deep walnut/chocolate shadows. Maintain a slightly matte luxury look (no neon colors, no oversaturation, no cold/blue tint). The scene should feel cozy, high-end, and sunset-lit, with gentle contrast and clean clarity.
Place the walnut relief on a matching walnut stand on an executive desk inside a luxurious modern office with dark wood tones and minimal décor. Illuminate with warm cinematic sunset light coming through tall floor-to-ceiling windows. Add a soft-focus city skyline in the distance. Lighting should highlight the carving depth and wood texture without harsh shadows.
Add clean, sharp engraved text carved into the wood beneath the portrait:
PromptPlum.Com | Prompt Library
Turning ideas into stunning visuals with AI.

Aspect ratio 4:5.
